jobs.description: Tank driver ADR Transport People • Pernis Rotterdam  Gemeente, provincie  Tank driver ADR  Transport People • Pernis Rotterdam Bedrijfsomschrijving Our client is the leader of national and international transport of fuels, lubricating oils, LPG, industrial gasses, LNG, bitumen and chemicals. Deliveries are completed around the Benelux to depots, industrial companies, labs, hospitals and gas stations. The company runs with day and night shifts. Functieomschrijving  - You drive a tanker truck and deliver fuel to gas stations. Functie-eisen  - As a tank driver ADR, you need a drivers license CE and code 95. - 1-2 years experience as a CE driver in the Netherlands. - Speaking English is very important. - You have an ADR tank certificate and experience with driving in the Netherlands or Belgium with an ADR tank. - Working on weekends and night shifts are not a problem for you. Arbeidsvoorwaarden  - Salary conforms €19,63 the first 3 months, and after these 3 months €20,41 gross per hour. - The first 6 weeks are a training period, which are of course paid, to make sure you will get all the information you need. - Surcharges for overtime and night hours between 130% and 150%. - Weekly payment of your salary. - Solid contact with Transport People. - Company housing, if needed. Sollicitatieprocedure Do you like this job opportunity and do you want to be a tank driver ADR? Send your CV to work@transportpeople.nl or call us on +31 85 48 35 895.

The jobAt EU Facility Services, the facility label of Covebo, we believe in “Simply well organized.”This means: good housing, clear rules and practical solutions. Together we make sure our international employees feel welcome and can live comfortably during their time in the Netherlands.Because quality is important to us, we are looking for someone who is hands-on, technical and can keep an overview. In this role you are an important part of our technical team!Your tasks- Setting up and furnishing (new) accommodation in accordance with applicable laws, regulations and SNF standards.- Painting walls, replacing flooring, maintaining gardens and carrying out minor repairs and maintenance, such as replacing or installing lights, hanging curtains, etc.- Identifying any issues or irregularities, discussing them with your colleagues and working together to find the best solution.- Delivering furniture, equipment and other items to House of Covebo accommodation.- Clearing out accommodation that is no longer being used by our international employees.- Ensuring that house rules and safety regulations are followed, because safety always comes first!At Covebo, and also at EU Facility Services you can simply be yourself. But we also like to see that you take initiative and have perseverance. As a Housing & Maintenance Worker you will have a very varied, international job where you work independently. You are always in contact with different departments and colleagues, and you contribute to building a world of work that is “Simply well arranged.” You are communicative, stress-resistant, and good at planning and setting priorities. For this role we are looking for a real doer, someone who does not mind rolling up their sleeves to take care of small technical tasks. jobs.description: Location: Purmerend, NetherlandsWorking Conditions: Cold storage at 8°CJob Description:We are seeking dedicated and motivated individuals to work in our salad production facility.This role involves working in a chilled environment, ensuring the preparation and packaging of fresh, high-quality salads.Main Responsibilities:- Preparing, packaging, and conducting quality checks on salad products.- Operating production machinery (training provided).- Maintaining cleanliness and order in the workplace.- Following all hygiene and safety protocols.Requirements:- Basic communication skills in English are required.- Availability for a minimum of 6 months, with potential for vacation during the contract.- Willingness to work flexible shifts depending on production needs.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.Working Hours:Day Shifts:- From 8:30 to 17:00 or 7:00 to 15:00.Night/Evening Shifts:- Start at 18:00 and finish upon task completion, depending on the volume of orders (typically between 2:00 and 4:00).Additional Compensation:- Overtime (above 40 hours): 125% pay rate.- Sundays and Public Holidays: 200% pay rate.Night Shifts:- From 19:00 to 23:00 – 125% pay rate.- From 23:00 to 06:00 – 140% pay rate.- Sundays starting at 23:00 – 140% pay rate.What We Offer:A competitive base hourly wage, with bonuses for evening, night, and holiday shifts.Vacation pay (8% of gross annual salary) and paid vacation days in line with Dutch labor law.A supportive and diverse team environment.Opportunities for training and professional development.Assistance with housing and transportation if necessary.If you are ready, apply today and become part of our team!

As a CE Truck Driver at Farm Trans, you transport products from Oudenhoorn to Maasvlakte using modern trucks and automated trailers. What will you do? As a CE Truck Driver, you provide reliable transport between Oudenhoorn and Maasvlakte. You work with modern trucks and automated trailers, making loading and unloading efficient and physically undemanding. Your work helps keep the logistics process running smoothly and safely. - Transporting products between Oudenhoorn and Maasvlakte. - Driving a modern truck with the latest safety features. - Working with automated trailers for loading and unloading. - Following the fixed shift schedule, alternating between early and late shifts. - Communicating professionally with colleagues and customers. - Following safety procedures and maintaining high-quality standards. What do you bring? To succeed as a CE Truck Driver, you are reliable, safety-conscious and comfortable working independently as well as part of a team. - You are in possession of a CE driving license, code 95 and a digital driver card. - You have experience with a tractor/trailer combination. - A flexible, service-oriented attitude and a strong focus on quality. - Good communication skills and willingness to work alternating early and late shifts. - You are fluent in English. What can you expect from us? In this role, you drive four to six trips per day between our factory and the warehouse. You work 4 shifts a week, 12 hours per shift. One week you work an early shift (4:00-16:00) and the other week you work a night shift (16:00-4:00). You are paid for the entire shift, minus the mandatory break.
